🇻🇳 Vietnam – Main Attractions by Destination
1. Da Nang
My Khe Beach
Golden Bridge (Ba Na Hills)
Marble Mountains
Dragon Bridge
Son Tra Peninsula & Lady Buddha
Hoi An Ancient Town (day trip)

2. Dong Hoi
Phong Nha–Ke Bang National Park
Paradise Cave
Phong Nha Cave
Dark Cave

3. Ninh Binh
Trang An Boat Tour
Tam Coc Boat Tour
Hang Mua Viewpoint
Bai Dinh Pagoda
Hoa Lu Ancient Capital
Bich Dong Pagoda

4. Hanoi
Hanoi Train Street
Hoan Kiem Lake
Hanoi Old Quarter
Temple of Literature
Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
Thang Long Imperial Citadel
West Lake & Tran Quoc Pagoda
Dong Xuan Market

5. Ho Chi Minh City
Cu Chi Tunnels
War Remnants Museum
Independence Palace
Saigon Central Post Office
Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon
Ben Thanh Market
Mekong Delta (day trip)

🇻🇳 Vietnam Trip Planning Tips

🛂 Vietnam Visa: Apply through the official website 👉 https://evisa.gov.vn/

🏨 Where to Stay?
📍 Da Nang: Near My Khe Beach
📍 Hoi An: Near the Ancient Town
📍 Hanoi: Old Quarter
📍 Ho Chi Minh City: District 1

💡 These are my personal recommendations based on my travel experience. Choose your accommodation, activities and bookings according to your budget, preferences and travel plans.

⚠️ Disclaimer: These are suggestions for planning purposes only. Please verify all details before booking. I am not responsible for third-party websites, services, bookings, cancellations or any issues arising from them. Always check the official visa website for the latest requirements.

❤️ Plan your Vietnam trip your way!
